answer.approach: Build responsive header as semantic markup first; use utilities for spacing, layout, type and state feedback. Include this evidence: flex, md:, <nav, gap-, focus-visible:.
review_checklist: Test keyboard focus and narrow-screen layout.
Check meaningful alternative text and contrast when relevant.
